blockdesc-opticshousing:
A housing for glass optics panels that focuses an oil lamp beacon's light to reach further out to sea. <icon>rightmousebutton</icon> with a wrench to fit up to three Lens Panels (setting its beam count, width, and color).
<icon>rightmousebutton</icon> a beacon with it in hand to attach, <hk>shift</hk>+<hk>ctrl</hk>+<icon>rightmousebutton</icon> to remove it. Fit at least one panel for the range bonus to apply.

seamarks:craftinginfo-seamarks-text: Seamarks: Beacons & Lighthouses by Fowl Fire Beacons Simple Fire Beacons are fueled with any coal, firewood, or peat and ignited with a torch or firestarter to burn for up to 24hrs. They can be seen from a few hundred blocks away. Oil Lamp Beacons Oil Lamp Beacons are fueled only by oils. They're much brighter than fire beacons and produce light that can be seen from up to a thousand blocks away without any enhancements. This range can be extended to another thousand blocks by adding up to four gold, silver, or electrum plates and affixing an Optics Housing overtop. A beacon's range also extends by four blocks for every block above y-level=0 that it's sitting at. This can be adjusted live along with most other parameters with Config Lib. By default, these beacons have a single reflector which casts light in one direction (facing the player when placed down) and at far distances can only be viewed from this direction. Attaching an Optics Housing with multiple lenses will produce multiple beams which can be seen from many directions. Supplying mechanical power to the bottom of the beacon like an automated quern will make the reflector/housing spin, causing its light to be visible from all directions. The Governor can be used to cap the spin of the reflector/housing.
seamarks:configlib-fire-baserange-commen: How far a fire beacon reaches sitting at sea level (before any height bonus).
seamarks:configlib-fire-rangeperelevatio: Extra blocks of range for each block the beacon stands above the height below. Set to 0 to make placement height count for nothing.
seamarks:configlib-fire-elevationstart-c: Height above sea level where the range-per-height bonus begins. A beacon below this only gets the base range.
seamarks:configlib-fire-falloffstart-com: Fraction of the maximum range where the distant marker starts to dim.
seamarks:configlib-fire-fuelburnmultipli: Scales how long each piece of solid fuel burns. 2 makes every fuel last twice as long.
seamarks:configlib-fire-maxfuelhours-com: Maximum burn time a fire beacon can hold at once.
seamarks:configlib-fire-raindouse-commen: When on, heavy rain with open sky above can extinguish a lit fire beacon.
seamarks:configlib-fire-requiresfuel-com: When off, a fire beacon lights with no fuel and stays lit forever (fuelling still works, it just isn't needed).
seamarks:configlib-fire-blipsizescale-co: Scales the size of the distant light marker (and its smoke marker). 1 is the default size.
seamarks:configlib-oil-baserange-comment: How far an oil lamp beacon reaches sitting at sea level (before plates housing or height bonuses).
seamarks:configlib-oil-rangeperelevation: Extra blocks of range for each block the beacon stands above the height below. Set to 0 to disable the bonus.
seamarks:configlib-oil-elevationstart-co: Height above sea level where the range-per-height bonus begins. A beacon below this only gets the base range.
seamarks:configlib-oil-falloffstart-comm: Fraction of the maximum range where the distant marker starts to dim.
seamarks:configlib-oil-maxfuellitres-com: Maximum oil an oil lamp beacon can hold. With hours-per-litre this sets its longest burn.
seamarks:configlib-oil-fuelhoursperlitre: How many hours of light one litre of oil fuels.
seamarks:configlib-oil-requiresfuel-comm: When off, an oil lamp beacon lights with no oil and stays lit forever (fuelling still works, it just isn't needed).
seamarks:configlib-oil-housingbonus-comm: Range added by a fitted Optics Housing.
seamarks:configlib-oil-platebonus-gold-c: Range added per gold plate (plates stack with diminishing returns).
seamarks:configlib-oil-platebonus-silver: Range added per silver plate. (plates stack with diminishing returns).
seamarks:configlib-oil-platebonus-electr: Range added per electrum plate. (plates stack with diminishing returns).
seamarks:configlib-oil-beamlength-commen: How far the focused beam draws when an Optics Housing is fitted (look only, no effect on range).
seamarks:configlib-oil-beamlengthnohousi: How far the bare lamp's beam draws with no housing (look only, no effect on range).
seamarks:configlib-oil-blipsizescale-com: Scales the size of the distant light marker (1 is the default size).
seamarks:configlib-rotation-tracksworldt: When on, a driven beacon follows the world clock, so it stops with /time stop and hurries when time is sped up. Turn it off and the optic keeps turning at its normal rate whatever the world clock is doing. Fuel still burns on world time either way.
seamarks:configlib-map-showblips-comment: When on, every lit beacon appears on the world map's Beacons layer. Turn it off to keep beacon locations off the map.
seamarks:cmd-error-nohousing: Look at an Optics Housing, either placed down or fitted to a beacon.
seamarks:cmd-eternal-on: This beacon will now burn forever, needing no fuel.
seamarks:cmd-eternal-off: This beacon burns normally again and will use fuel.
